name: cpp26-guard
description: Keep C++26 free of hand-written copies of definitions. Skills reflect-dont-hand-write (derive enum names, name lookups, flag parsing and member lists with std::meta reflection, with a tested reference header and a GCC 16.2 evidence table) and cpp26-idioms (constrained templates, import std, std::format and std::print, one append instead of a chain, opt-in comment policy), advisory pre-write and post-write hooks, two tested lints with allowance files, configured by .claude/cpp26-guard.json.
